newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: N.Korean ideologue to come to Seoul next week - radio.
newsitem.headline: N.Korean ideologue to come to Seoul next week - radio.

text.p: North Korea's top ideologue, sheltering in the Philippines after fleeing his impoverished nation through Beijing, will arrive in Seoul early next week, South Korea's state radio reported on Wednesday.
Korea Broadcasting System, quoting an unidentified government official, said Hwang Jang-yop would arrive in secret at an airbase with no public access.
"A transport plan has already been finalised for bringing Secretary Hwang to Seoul safely," the official was quoted as saying.
A foreign ministry spokesman said he was not aware of the plan.

Hwang, a secretary of the powerful secretariat of North Korea's ruling Workers' Party, was taken to an undisclosed hideout in the Philippines on March 18 after arriving in South Korea's consulate in Beijing on February 12 to seek asylum.

Hwang, chief architect of North Korea's governing ideology of "juche" or self reliance, was ranked 24th in North Korea's power hierarchy. He was the most senior Pyongyang official to flee the communist country.
